label: PF Backlog 519
title: Stage-0 product repo setup: recommend a GitHub repo name, confirm, create + connect the product remote
body:
## Problem / why
Product repos have NO remote (PF never creates a GitHub repo or adds a remote), so delivery is local-only. There is also no stage-0 step to name the product's repo.

## Goal & value
At stage 0, recommend a GitHub repo name from the idea, ASK (confirm), and on 'yes' create the repo + connect the product remote so delivery is real. Fail-closed local-only when gh/token is unavailable.

delivery.note: Stage-0 repo setup: recommend + confirm -> github.create_repo (gh/REST) + vcs.connect_remote; API POST/GET /projects/{p}/repo. merge --no-ff (no PR)

brief.problem: Product repos have no remote; delivery is local-only, and there is no stage-0 naming step.
brief.what_adds: Recommended repo name + confirm gate + GitHub repo creation + remote connection, exposed API-first and wired at stage 0.
brief.why: Make product delivery real (push to the product's own GitHub repo), safely (only on confirmation).

objective: Recommend a product repo name at stage 0, require confirmation, then create the GitHub repo (gh/REST) and connect the product remote; API-first; fail-closed local-only otherwise.
acceptance_criteria: repo_setup.recommend_name(project, idea) returns a slug recommendation
no repo is created without confirm=True (fail-closed); gh->REST; no gh/token -> local-only with reason
on confirm: create the repo and connect the product remote (core.vcs.connect_remote)
stage-0 (run_pipeline new) prints the recommendation; creates only when enabled (PF_CREATE_PRODUCT_REPO)
approach: Add create_repo (gh else REST token, fail-closed) + vcs.connect_remote; a repo_setup owner that recommends+confirms+creates+connects and records on project.json; a /projects/{p}/repo API; and a stage-0 hook in run_pipeline (recommend always; create only when enabled).

prior_decisions: single owners: vcs=git, github=optional gh; API-first; no new store/engine; legacy dashboard frozen

risks: creating a real repo requires gh/token; default is opt-in/local-only

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/github.py, core/model_recommendation.py, core/product_analyzer.py, core/product_design_spec.py

_note: Delivered + validated (5 tests pass, gate OK, api-governance 152 paths in sync, wired-audit unwired 0, lint 0 NEW)
